reviews.text: Does not allow you to log in. The app is barely functional since it was “improved”

A bit of a mess. I attempted a recipe tonight from their app (sheet pan chicken, potatoes and broccoli). I printed the recipe and it was missing a lot of information provided in the app. The problem with the app is the words ran off the side and you can’t pinch to fit in the screen. The printed version didn’t match and included cook times of “3600 minutes.” I also put things in my cart from the recipe and it caused me to overbuy! It put 4 lbs of chicken in my cart when 1.5 lbs was needed. Same with the potatoes. 5 lbs of potatoes for 1 lb needed. I tried going to the website from my phone and it kept kicking me back to the app which was NOT helpful. Fix these bugs please!!!

Buggy and Unreliable. This app is extremely buggy. I almost never can just open it and find what I’m looking for. It either wants yet another update, or it inexplicably randomly assigns me to stores in other states, say 100 or more miles away, even though there’s a Wegmans about six miles from my house. I’ve repeatedly configured the local store as my preferred store. That may hold for a while, and then I’ll find myself search for an item in a store two states away. Yesterday, the app once again required an update and then, once again, forced me to reenter my demographic data, including my home address, and then randomly assigned me to the Wegmans store in Pittsfield, NY. I’ve never been to Pittsfield, NY and don’t even know where it is. (I was trying to find tomato paste. I had to ask a clerk because the app failed. Turns out, it and tomato sauce are in an aisle of the separate international food section… ) Wegmans really needs a working app.

Great shopping app!. Have been using the Wegmans app for years now and always pleased with the updates. The only thing that is frustrating is under ‘Lists’ we can make shopping specific lists then can check each item off when purchased. The checked items stay in that list forever and it takes forever to delete. Can you make an ‘edit’ feature which would enable us to go down the list and delete items all at once?.

New Updates makes shopping more difficult. I like the system with the “get it” / “got it” lists, but having items that are on my “got it” show up as a number when I’m searching is really frustrating. When I search an item, it looks like it’s already on my list and then I go to the store and forget to get something because it’s on my “got it” list that I’m not looking at. Do I need to clear out the “got it” list after every trip!?? Items on that list shouldn’t show up in searches as if they’re already on my list.

reviews.text: Wegmans Doesn’t Get It. The app update of redesigning the shopping list to Get it/Got it is the worst thing to happen to this app. Item counts are jacked up. Items get accidentally bumped to the got it list while actively shopping in store. I’m going to a paper list for shopping in future until this gets resolved. Too many trips back to the store to get things I wanted and didn’t bring home. It’s like they’re doing in on purpose.

reviews.text: Bugs Galore. This app is always buggy. The most current bug is an error logging in. Other bugs consist of items not showing up in the search, the shoppers club card doesn’t scan, and sometimes my shopping list get deleted on its own.
Judy michelsen. Used their pharmacy today one busy place

Can’t sign in for about a year, tried everything. “Something went wrong, can’t sign you in, try again later”. I’ve tried changing my password. Trying a new email. Tried deleting and redownloading the app. It’s a mess. No answer from. Wegmans
Notifications. There’s no way to customize notifications to stop the constant ads. If there is, it’s not easy to find.

Love it. I love being able to make my shopping list in the app and it being organized my aisle and section. It helps me to be able to quickly navigate through the store. I also love that it helps me keep within my budget by showing me my total. 

The only thing I wish was that the total price was at the top of the list instead of the bottom. Sometimes if I have a longer list, it takes couple scrolls to get to the bottom and I inadvertently will click “got it” on some items while I’m scrolling.

reviews.text: Hasn’t worked and still doesn’t. Over a year ago I got so fed up with the app not working (wouldn’t even let me sign in or show coupons) that I had to delete and use the website. That was all good and fine until today when the digital coupon link said “this page is no longer available”. I spoke to a store employee and they said let’s try the app again because it’s gone through a lot of revisions and now works properly. So, downloaded the app and sure enough doesn’t even allow me to sign in! Wegmans has one of the worst working apps I’ve ever encountered. So now I can’t use the app nor does the website work properly.

Recent Update Ruined Search Results. The original Wegmans app search results actually included all relevant items. Now most relevant items are excluded in every search. It is frustrating and the entire reason I would use an app.
Great store horrible application. App is wonky and constantly updating

Frustrating is an understatement. It’s great. When it works. Which is only occasionally. 

The search feature where you can sort by “my items” is nice, but the search just simply doesn’t show all the items, often I need to add a similar item just to get me in the right aisle to find why I actually want. 

And just today I made my whole list, and then added one final item. The entire list reset and the only item on it was that last item. 

So. Frustrating.

reviews.text: Another ruined app. It used to be great. Then they started redesigning and improving it until it became unusable. It is hungrier for updates than my cats. It doesn't log you in automatically. I now barely use it. Select all coupons button was eliminated. Bet it was outsourced to an offshore company for development

Not what I was expecting. Personally the app is horrible. The coupons are nice but the app in itself is terrible. It never works and constantly signs me out. I have been In several situations where I was stuck unable to use the coupons I needed because it signed me out. I believe it’s a bug in the app but it’s been like this for the seven months I’ve had it. My phone number never works either, which is weird because it takes the shoppers club with my phone number but doesn’t let me use the coupons.

The worst ever!. This is probably the worst generation of this app ever. Good luck navigating this thing in under 15 minutes. Takes forever to find your shoppers club card let alone find anything else epic fail.
Terrible app. Love Wegmans but hate this app. Please make it better. It’s so glitchy.

Designed by folks who don’t need sales. We love Wegmans but the app needs help. I know they don’t really do sales to the extent of competitors, nevertheless give your customers a break and add the loyalty card to Apple Wallet and provide an *easy to find* tab for sale items. 

I do appreciate the shopping tab that automatically arranges my shopping list according to the store’s layout, that’s a genius move that most other grocery apps fail to implement.

reviews.text: Used to Be Better. I miss being able to see how far my shopper is in picking up the items for my order. Since that was removed, I have no way of knowing which items they’ve grabbed so far and how long it might take them to finish. Additionally, the app is very buggy. For example, if I approved a replacement earlier and am then asked to approve another replacement later, it shows me that the first replacement I approved is no longer approved. It also takes forever to add items once an order is already placed. Overall I think the app needs additional testing to work out some of these issues.

reviews.text: Do Better. This app needs to be better. Once you place your order the app does not allow to add anything.
Not user friendly. The ability to create effective lists has no user friendly flow . . . ?

Buggy. Works functionally most of the time, but not user friendly. 

Adding items to a future order gets annoying
Jitters. Always something with each update. Now the app has the jitters, wildly moving up and down. On the upside, when ticking off items while shopping the response has improved dramatically, TY!

Can’t log on!. What happened? I used to use this on a regular basis but now I can’t log on. “Something went wrong! Please try again later” is the only clue I get. A completely useless message. Tell me what went wrong!

Needs price updates to instore shopping list. Great app that I use all the time. I keep everything I am ever likely to buy in my list. I look at it to help me prepare for in-store shopping. The list used to automatically show loyalty card discounts and automatically update any price changes, but now these updates are not happening. I have had some surprises at the store. Please restore the price updates.

Doesn't show if items in/out of stock. If they don't show whether items are in or out of stock, I'm not wasting my time going to the store or ordering online!
Get with the times, Wegman's!
Can’t log in. I usually love this app, but I keep getting a message that “something went wrong” and I should “try again later.” Please fix this bug!
Digusting. Literally gave me the wrong my food I ate it and could of died bc I’m allergic.
👍. Kudos for the recent app improvements! Specifically: 1) Recognizing which store I’m in and automatically switching 👏 2) Adding more specific locations within “Dairy” 👏

So Slow. I want to love the app so much. I love to use it for navigating the aisles quickly. But it is so so slow and I just installed an update and the app won’t even open. It would be great if it worked well.

Downward trajectory. I love Wegmans and using the app, but every update seems to make the use and functionality considerably worse. After the latest update I cannot even open the app. Previous versions were much cleaner organized by aisle, easier transfer from saves list to shopping list, etc. Hopefully a new update that restores functionality is coming soon.

reviews.text: Slow, glitchy with lags. I so want to like this app. I want to use it when I go to the store, but they’ve made it unusable. There is such a lag. When I type, it takes a few seconds for the screen to catch up. Not only is this annoying, but unfortunately it makes the app unusable.

No, I don’t want to reset my password. I find the app clunky.. get to the store click on a
bunch of
coupons and the app freezes. Oops something went wrong please sign in
Forgot password 
Get to checkout and cashier says would you like to reset your password I look at the line behind me
So I wind up at the customer service counter to get my $3.00
Not all that convenient

Overheating your phone. When I use this app it overheat my phone and eventually it dies, asking for restart. There must be some glitch in the code or poor architecture or endless background processing. Please don’t over complicate the app, or have feature that can be turned on/off depending on the user choice. Anyways I gave it 5 start since it is much better than the previous version.

It was good once….. I use this app for creating a grocery list and this app used to be good. However during one of their updates, this app went from useable to utter trash. It doesn’t want me to check off items as I shop. It randomly reorders my list as I shop instead of keeping it by aisle. When I go into the “got it” section to add items back to my main list for the next week, it doesn’t want me to uncheck the items. Nor does it want me to be able to delete them. It is slow. Buggy. And makes my shopping experience not as pleasant as it used to be. Honestly I might go back to my old paper list or notes app.

fix it. this app continues to be updated but loses functionality. i can’t even watch my live order anymore. it’s also difficult to find our usual purchases and search for them. i don’t need the list feature, i just want the cart. figure it out

reviews.text: In store ease. Love to use it to find stuff easily when I’m in store.

reviews.text: Stop forcing frequent app updates!. Other apps do releases without forcing users to update immediately but this is one of the rare apps that forces you to update with every single release!! Wegmans should fire these app developers!!

It keeps getting worse - I miss the old app. Each update seems to replace an old problem with a new one. First the search was slow and lagging. Now that it’s faster, the search results are horrible. If you don’t know the exact product name, it’s impossible to find what you’re looking for. The old app was perfect. This one is making the shopping experience so much harder than it needs to be.
Annoying App Updates. Why are you releasing FORCED app updates like every two weeks?? It’s fine to update the app, but why in the world would you make them forced? It’s incredibly annoying.

Good to check prices but that’s it right now. The app used to be one of the easiest to use, but since their update months ago, I can’t log in to my account anymore. This means that I can’t make a shopping list, check past purchases, or clip coupons. It’s still useful to check prices and maybe stock, but that’s it. Don’t bother making an account. Well, you can’t anyway. I’ve tried reaching out to the developers at least twice, maybe thrice, but they don’t even acknowledge it to be a problem on their end, as if they don’t even want to believe that the sign-in page is inaccessible.
Missing my favorite feature. Please add the ability to add rewards card/barcode to Apple wallet. This is such a great feature for loyalty apps.

Goofy search. I have no clue how they indexed their catalog but the search is rough. The box itself lags on input causing typos, and results are sorted strangely. If you aren’t searching for something you normally buy, good luck. I also find the “swipe to get” feature to be unreliable, much preferred the old checkbox system to mark items off my list

Go Back. Please undo. Two or so versions back and just stay there. It searched, it was easy to navigate, it was fast, and notes displayed in list. 
I am about to return to pen and paper. 
Software team, don’t fix it if it isn’t broken.
It’s still broken, it was so good, and now it just frustrates me. 
Sort by aisle should do just that… 20 comes after 16, but on this app.

reviews.text: App is a slow buggy mess. The app was in a decent spot previously but since they updated it a month or so ago, it’s been an absolute nightmare. Search feature is still terrible, sorting of the list is buggy and makes no sense for the store layout, you need to click multiple times to try and check something off your list and even when you do it takes 5-10 seconds to register sometimes. You need to either fire or re-evaluate your dev team.

UI Redesign results in slow and laggy performance. I’ve been awaiting an update that corrects the lag users experience on critical features since your new architecture was launched:

1. item search (your attempt to preload results is what’s slowing you down, user clicks return key after typing but, oh, wait for the preload before you go to next step. Your sequencing and timeouts are not aligned. 

2. Item clearing when shopping. I should haven’t to wait for more than 250ms when tapping on an item to say I’ve got it. Especially when I want to select multiple in a row. 

Your previous architecture seemed to have performed better.

- A concerned lover of Wegmans

Slow and bloated. The app has always been slow, but lately it is really dragging. The get it got it list separation is irritating and makes everything even slower somehow. Deleting items from the checked off list takes ages since each delete causes a mini refresh of the page so you can’t quickly delete several items in succession. Also the clickable field for the check boxes and for any back button or “x” to get off that page is so small I have to attempt the action multiple times before my fat thumb finally hits the right spot. Ultimately the app is useful for finding locations of items but using it as a list is frustrating and has pushed me to other list apps and methods.

Only 1 problem. This app is awesome - it really is. I like the list feature and the digital coupons !!! No more writing down grocery lists with pen and paper AND no more clipping coupons with scissors and a paper ad. Both of which can be time consuming. Yay !!! The only thing I don’t like is you don’t offer Apple Pay for online/delivery orders. That’s very disappointing. I don’t like giving my actual card information to websites or businesses or apps unless absolutely necessary. That’s why I love Apple Pay - businesses still get paid but they don’t know my actual card information. So it’s extremely safe and secure from a financial standpoint. Why oh why do you not offer Apple Pay as a payment option for online orders ?????

reviews.text: Love the app!. Great for delivery and pickup. I find what I need every time, and I like the recommendations for new things to try. The meals feature is great. I love meal planning with it. The app feels much smoother lately. Love the coupons!

St Bernard’s shuttle. The two people generally assigned to take care of our contingent, Matt & Mari, could not be more suited to this task. We have some ornery old curmudgeons and they never blink!
I generally go through Matt’s line and he always makes sure that I found everything I needed. If not, he sends someone to bring it to me! I’m not really good with using my SNAP benefits card, but he walks me through it every time. I’d be exasperated with me at this point, but Matt is so patient and accommodating.
And Mari? I can’t say enough about her. One of our members is a large man who is completely blind. Mari has made him her “special person”. She treats him like he is a family member from start to finish. She is so very kind to him. I’m sure he feels it, but probably isn’t able to express it to corporate. She makes him feel valued.
Those of us who are able to take advantage of the shuttle from St Bernard’s truly appreciate everything you do for us, but I just wanted to let you know how much we appreciate Matt & Mari.
Please give them a special shout out from all of us 

Julia Teahan 
St Bernard’s family

It’s like someone is trying to kill off Wegmans business. Either someone in the engineering team is trying to sabotage the business from within or there is so much chaos that no one knows what’s going on. Either way the result is an app that stopped working. It just doesn’t let me login, period. 

I used to be able to just hop over to the website and do the shopping there instead, however now the “improvements” finally spread to the website as well. Last couple of weeks My Items wasn’t working (wouldn’t add them to the cart) and I had to search for all the items one by one. Now it won’t let me login. Great job!

SO SLOW. This app ruins my day every time I have to use it. It’s been ridiculously slow since the redesign, which was a long time ago now. There’s no excuse for this extreme downgrade to not have been fixed yet. Please fix it or put it back to the way it was!

Rehire whoever you let go because this app has taken a massive nosedive. Who on their product team did Wegmans leadership let go? Get them back. Because whoever you’ve got working on this now doesn’t know what they’re doing. Is it interns? Did you think you could save money with AI coding? Wegmans should be embarrassed by this app. In the meantime, rollback this laggy and buggy version and go back to the one that worked.

most recent iteration of app is a step backwards. so using the app that was updated two days ago during the week of June 16, 2025, the app does not show delivery in progress on a map, the app does not allow for corrections to be made when the shopper does not find a particular item.

reviews.text: Love the concept and functions but very slow and frustrating.. The search is slow and hangs on basic searches. Deleting items off the list takes at least a minute apiece and screws up the list at times. Due to the slowness of the app checking items off the list and back on the list is very cumbersome and frustrating. Sometimes adding ingredients from a recipe does not work but does not tell you it did not work. I am a regular user of this application but I am thinking of not using it due to its performance issues.
You fixed it!. Performance improvements are immediately noticeable and much appreciated. Love using the app again.
Awful lag and slow search results. Love the store but the app is getting worse with every update! The search doesn’t work and it takes forever to load my list!

“Something went wrong” message every use. App never lets me sign in. It always says “Something went wrong. Please try again later.” I’ve uninstalled and reinstalled the app, and it still doesn’t ever work.

Idk who designs the app now but. The biggest issue for me right now is we used to be able to see what items had been shopped so far on pickup orders, and what was left. There’s buttons that say view order but they don’t work. At least for me it doesn’t work, after I approve a change .. it’s also REALLY SLOW.. where is the chat function when the shopper is shopping? It only comes up as texts

reviews.text: Used to be fast/great…. This app used to be awesome - it helped navigate the store and you could quickly check off items that you tossed into your cart. After the recent updates, the app has become SLOW and laggy even though it’s running on an iPhone 16 Pro. Specifically, there is a notable and frustrating lag when checking off items while shopping. It checks a box, slides off the side of the screen, then waits a second or two before sliding the list up. It’s hard to deal with when trying to quickly navigate the store. Not sure if it’s lagging due to the new animations or what, but it’s clunky and feels like a resource hog now.

App has a lot of issues. This app is good in theory but ever since the most recent update it has a TON of issues. First of all, my phone starts burning up when I use the app. Secondly, the responsiveness is painfully slow. Finally, and worst of all, I add items and then they are not there later…just disappears. Very frustrating as we rely on it for grocery shopping.
Terrible app that makes shopping harder. This app is the slowest and laggiest I’ve ever seen. I never do app reviews but this one is so terrible I felt compelled to do one for this.

Best Grocery App by far!. The only change I’d like to see made on the next update is to NOT include “Got It” items in the red list bubble. It messes with my mind when I open the app and see 60 items “on my list” =) other than that, well done developers!!

Kick out. I’m trying to add to my food list in the app but like every week the app logs me out and I don’t remember the password off hand and i got to update my food list which now I can’t, this is most inconvenient time for the app to do this to me. The abs previous set up before the update was way better than this. It’s design was way better than this. I don’t know what the people at the App Store or Wegmans was thinking, but you guys definitely need a better perspective.

Sadly it is so. This app has great features. Saving my items. Allowing me to have two lists. However, moving items from the “get it” to “got it” lists is ridiculously painful. You can’t move multiple items at a time. It’s rather frustrating.

reviews.text: Super Laggy. As much as I like Wegmans as a chain, the in-app search feature is almost impossible to use. Basically any item I type in will make the app lag out for 20-30 seconds, so I’ve just started building my shopping list on the website instead. The only reason I still have the app downloaded is the feature that tell me the exact aisle and section of each item I have, so it makes the actual shopping experience easier. Please fix the horrendous lag and I’d have no problem changing my rating to five stars!!

The previous app was better. For all its flaws, the previous app was better. This new app is much slower all around. Search is slow and results reorder themselves when you try to select one. And marking an item off the list moves it to another sublist with the slowest UI transition ever - I want to get through my shopping list quickly and that does not help. This new app is prettier, but also much slower.

constant freezing. I love Wegmans but the app is awful no matter how many times they redo it. My service will be working just fine and my internet speed will be fast- yet somehow the Wegmans app will take 5+ minutes to load a single item :( I just want to prepare my cart but I don’t have all day. It will close randomly as well. Sad.

App. Wegmans app has me update every week when I'm at the check out. I think that it will be fine as I updated 7 days ago and then the wifi is terrible so it won't update in store and cannot use it. They should just automatically give discounts instead of having to use this app and in store coupons that are on it
reviews.theme: список покупок и навигация по магазину

reviews.text: Slow to search. The search feature is significantly slower than it used to be. It makes the app kind of a pain to use

Garbage. Whatever recent updates crated where the app forces you to sign in every.single.time.you venture to use it and can’t understand that you’re looking to add items to you cart not see dogsh!t recipes and nothing matches where items are in store. Absolute dumpster app developer investment.

New performance is poor. I really like some aspects of the new app, like the “Get It/Got It” feature, but the performance is atrocious. Checking items off is frustrating because there’s a significant lag between tapping and response, and then the screen repaints. I suspect the app is interacting with the Wegmans web servers in near real time, and that’s the wrong approach. More caching, less waiting, please. Searching is laggy and buggy, too, but again, I think this is due to the overall poor performance of the underlying website itself, which is slow even with a web browser. Keep up with the improvements, even with the frustrating bugs, it’s invaluably useful to me.

No Control of Notification Types. The app works well for grocery pickup, the frequent promotional notifications, which you can’t disable, are very frustrating. I’m going to turn off all notifications to end the issue
Search function is TERRIBLE. Searching for anything is such a pain now - the app is so slow and glitchy. Whatever you did in the last redesign, please undo it!!

The update is horrible. With the recent update, I’m not able to see the progress of shopping. Now there is no way to know if a shopper took the order, but has not started shopping, went unresponsive, and is going to hold the order for hours (while the status is Shopping Started) until I call the support to cancel. This has happened to me a few times. 

I also can’t see now how far the person is from my house so I can estimate when to be ready to open the door. 

My whole multi-year shopping history is gone. I used to go back sometimes to check which items I’ve bought in the past. 

“My Items” is empty, since the whole order history got deleted. 

The shopper’s rating is also gone.

I can see the apartment number before the order is placed. After the order is placed, however, with the new update, the apartment number line is gone. I have to write a note to a shopper to give them my apartment number. Today I forgot to do that and a shopper had to call me.

App notifications are gone as well.

Update: now I shop only through the Instacart app.

reviews.text: App redesign is a fail. The app redesign makes the app almost impossible to use. Takes several minutes to search each item. If you have all day to make a list, great. But then when you try to delete or check an item, it usually takes about 5-10 tries to actually work.

New changes are awful. They updated the app to 24.6.1 and the changes have made it unusable. Checking off items is incredibly slow and sometimes the items just come right back onto the list. Because of the delay sometimes you simply check off other items and unintentionally miss getting something. 

The get it/got it function needs work. It’s great in theory, but when you search for something and it’s in the got it section, then you have to go to that section and wait for it to load and search through that list to un-click it. Then if you want more/less, then you have to go to the get it section and change the amount. 

Searching for items is sooooooo sloooow. You search and it changes pages 3-4 times. It’s so frustrating.

RIP to a useful app. Please go back to the way the app was like 6 months ago. Part of why I loved Wegmans more than other stores was it had the best app interface and list feature, but now it can’t seem to find products the store definitely has, lags every time you press anything, and is generally impossible to use. Why even make this update when everything was working so well?
Still bad. The app is still so glitchy and slow to respond.

Searching / updating cart. Since the update, searching for products using the search bar, as well as updating your cart to add or remove items, have become so laggy, and make the app near impossible to use

FIX THE APP. It is the WORST grocery store app. Nothing loads, it glitches and crashes constantly, and it’s so buggy. If I click a grocery item it takes so long to even register that something was clicked on. I end up furiously clicking until it works. Searching for a product a frustrating task that results in so much wasted time while I wait for the app to register that I am trying to click on the search bar. Making my shopping list has become an impossible task which is such a shame given how much I enjoy the in store experience. I’ve started going to ShopRite more despite having worse produce since their app actually works! Terrible user experience!
Slow, buggy unusable. It can’t find anything in search, hangs up, slow slow slow, absolutely painful to use and is frequently just gets the order wrong.

Frustrating. I love that you can make a list and check them off. But with a recent update, it doesn’t always list things in the order that you would come across the items in the store like it used to. And the search feature is super slow, as is its reaction to checking off an item. I have to tap it multiple times so I’m standing in the store, angrily tapping my phone until it works. And then sometimes it registers it, but I kept tapping so then it checks the next item off my list even though I haven’t gotten it yet.

reviews.text:
Absolutely HATE the Current App. I’ve used the Wegmans app for more than 500 orders over several years and each subsequent app release has improved significantly over the previous version. Until the current version. 

I can’t say this clearly enough: I. HATE. THE. CURRENT. APP. SO. MUCH. Here’s why:

1) The app doesn’t allow you to see what changes are being made when something is substituted or refunded. All you can do is try to remember everything you ordered and hope you get what you really need. Why? Because you don’t always get a notification from the shopper when they refund or substitute. Sometimes you do, but not always, so you can’t fix an issue in real time. You have to wait for the shopper to finish, read your receipt, check the items and quantities for which you were charged, and decide then whether to accept the changes or abandon your order. 

Case in point: a week or so ago, I ordered 8 boxes of my favorite flavor of Yasso yogurt bars when they were restocked. I had selected “do not replace” if the item was not available but the shopper decided to be note those instructions. I got one box of the flavor I ordered and 7 boxes of another flavor I did not want. I was forced to abandon my order so I wouldn’t be charged $35 for 7 boxes I didn’t want, request a refund, then waste them. 

2) You cannot rate your order or rectify any issues in the app until the order is marked completed. I have had to wait until the next day to report items missing, poor substitutions, and other issues. Wegmans has effectively discouraged their app users from submitting their feedback by making it much more difficult. I’m afraid this sends the message that Wegmans no longer cares as much about their customers’ experience. 

Unfortunately, a serious decline in the skill and accuracy of the shoppers has coincided with the current app’s release. I had an order a couple weeks back in which all my items were piled in two bags (wooHOO), but without any forethought: the shopped put our bread on the bottom of one bag and put raw ground chicken on top of fresh strawberries in the other (and the chicken leaked on the berries, contaminating them and forcing me to discard a $9 package of berries. 

I have had to question whether or not I can continue to use the Wegmans app for shopping orders. I love Wegmans, but I am frustrated. PLEASE, Wegmans: fix the issues with your app!!!

Wegmans App fails!. This App was so much better before. This update keeps logging me out. It has no history of my past purchases. It crashes. It stalls. 

I may need to try the Giant or Acme apps - that’s how bad this app has gotten. I love Wegmans but I also love ease of use and convenience.

Bring back the old version. The new update is the worst "improvement" ever. It glitches constantly, interrupts you when you're trying to type so instead of typing "white cheddar" you get "whcheddarite". The grocery lists are spread out and I have to scroll constantly to see everything I need in a particular aisle. And it just kicked me out and pretended I didn't have an account even though I've been using it for almost ten years. I'd rather go back to handwritten lists and getting lost in the (poorly reorganized) store than waste my time with this app. Or I could shop at Safeway and get the same experience.

update tanked the app. the app worked perfectly fine before. now you have to constantly restart the app and rephrase a simple search multiple times to even find a product you KNOW wegmans carries- making the app take more time than actual shopping would at this point.
Upset. Forced me to update while shopping but wouldn’t on the store wifi!!!

App has gone downhill. Placed an order for delivery through the app like I normally do and this time I and wasn’t able to update anything. Replacements didn’t save, chat feature with shopper is missing, it says my shopper is about to shop for 2 hours now but groceries are on my doorstep. I get text notifications for replacement approval after shopping is done. I’m just going to to use the instacart app as a workaround.
